title: ‘I Was Sold a Bill of Goods’: Americans and the Distrust Election
summary: Americans have a pervasive sense they are being lied to. That has created an unpredictability in politics unseen since Donald Trump said he could shoot someone on Fifth Avenue without losing voters.
